title: Looking Back: Life's What-Ifs
shared_passage: Listen to four people talk about past regrets. For questions 1 to 7, choose the correct answer (A, B, or C).

questions.question: Emma...
options: is planning to take a gap year.
wants to follow her passion.
did what others wanted for her.

questions.question: Which sentence is true about Emma?
options: She appreciates her parents' efforts.
Her parents encouraged her to explore different career paths.
She doesn't care what other people think.

questions.question: Jake...
options: could have got much more money for the truck if he'd waited.
regrets listening to his dad.
would like to buy a similar truck now.

questions.question: According to Jake...
options: He would have liked to keep the truck to sell it later.
His friends don't really know much about money either.
If he'd kept the truck, he'd be living down the coast now.

questions.question: Sarah...
options: isn't happy about her work conditions.
was afraid to pursue writing as a career.
stayed in her current job because she found out she was pregnant.

questions.question: Sarah...
options: says people have the wrong idea about work.
has just found her true passion.
thinks it's too late for a new career now.

questions.question: Daniel...
options: didn't really like piano lessons as a kid.
tried to have some regular practice during college.
hasn't given up the idea of learning again.
